categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in research, design, production and sales of military vehicle supporting equipment based on non-metallic composite materials. Main product lines include military vehicle human-machine-environment interior systems, ammunition equipment, military vehicle auxiliary equipment, military vehicle communication equipment, and unmanned aircraft. Products are widely applied in electronic information, armored combat, and armored support wheeled and tracked vehicle main battle equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core competencies center on non-metallic composite material performance research, process structure design, and application technology. Manufacturing methods include vacuum infusion, prepreg vacuum bag pressing, prepreg compression molding, and in-line impregnation compression molding. The company employs a 'two ends inside, middle outside' production model with in-house R&D, trial production, and small-batch manufacturing, while outsourcing large-scale forming, assembly, and painting operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are military equipment integrators and research institutes under major Chinese military industrial groups including China North Industries Group and China Electronics Technology Group. End markets include military armored vehicles (reconnaissance vehicles, command vehicles, tanks, infantry fighting vehicles) used by the Chinese military across land, naval, and rocket force branches. The company serves electronic information, armored combat, and armored support vehicle platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province. Operating regions include North China (47.45% of 2024 revenue), East China (30.27%), Central China (9.68%), Southwest China (4.50%), Northwest China (7.73%), and Northeast China (0.38%). The company has established presence in multiple military industrial bases and aerospace industry zones.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the military equipment supply chain. It functions as a Tier-1 supplier of composite material components and subsystems to military vehicle integrators and system-level enterprises, providing configured interior systems and auxiliary equipment rather than raw materials or finished vehicles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing composite material lightweight technology for military vehicles, developing modular integrated cockpit systems, advancing flame-retardant and anti-fragmentation lining technologies, and expanding applications in naval vessels, aerospace, and electronic warfare domains. The company emphasizes participation in early-stage military research projects to establish supplier relationships before batch production phases. R&D focuses on performance enhancement, cost reduction, and expanding product portfolio beyond core interior systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through direct sales of military composite material products and systems to military equipment integrators. Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance and verification of delivered products. The company operates on a make-to-order basis driven by military procurement contracts, with revenue split between research/development phase contracts and batch production contracts. Pricing is typically negotiated on a per-contract basis for R&D projects, while batch production pricing is established through competitive processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as an early entrant and established supplier in the military vehicle composite materials interior systems segment. Competition is limited due to high military industry barriers to entry. The company maintains competitive advantages through long-standing customer relationships with major military integrators, accumulated production experience, military certifications, and technical expertise. Specific named competitors are not disclosed, but the company acknowledges increasing competition as more enterprises enter the military composite materials field.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized military supplier with 2024 revenue of 107.74 million yuan, down 20.13% from 134.89 million yuan in 2023. The company reported a net loss of 10.89 million yuan in 2024 versus net profit of 11.54 million yuan in 2023. Total assets were 1.238 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in April 2023. Growth has been impacted by delayed customer acceptance of a major 111 million yuan contract and increased credit impairment provisions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced composite material technology enabling lightweight, high-strength military vehicle interiors that improve vehicle mobility and safety. Key value propositions include: one-piece integrated molding reducing component count, superior fire-resistance and anti-fragmentation properties, thermal and vibration management capabilities, and customized design solutions for specific vehicle platforms. The company emphasizes reliability through extensive testing in harsh military environments and participation in major military exercises and border operations.
